title: The Silent Revolution
subtitle: Awakening the Master Within: How a Timeless Movement Is Rebooting Humanity’s Operating System
hook: A book about the small gap between wanting something and choosing it, read through the teachings of Sree Sree Thakur Anukulchandra.

title: The Tardigrade Project
subtitle: You Were Warned…
credit: By Souvik Ghosh · Edited by Sandipan Pain
hook: In Kolkata, a virologist and an AI named Gopal face a pathogen that can learn. The trail leads them beneath Beijing.

title: The Architects’ Code
subtitle: Fragments, Fate, and the Future of Civilization
credit: By Souvik Ghosh · Edited by Sandipan Pain and Sayak Ray
hook: Fragments fall from the sky into a village. When Aria picks up their signal, a scientific puzzle becomes a race to understand who else is listening.

title: Blueprint for Peace
subtitle: Realizing the God Within
credit: By Dr. Buddhadev Chakraborty · Translated by Souvik Ghosh
hook: What would peace look like in the middle of a disagreement? Chakraborty writes about how a Living Ideal can guide our ordinary impulses.

title: The Nectar of Truth & The Festival of Being
subtitle: Sree Sree Thakur Anukulchandra’s Vision for Literature and Life
credit: By Rev. Dr. Buddhadev Chakraborty · Translated by Sri Souvik Ghosh
hook: Two essays on literature and life ask what responsibility a writer has to the people who read their words.

title: Light of the Supreme Fulfiller (Purushottam)
credit: By Dr. Buddhadev Chakraborty · Translated by Souvik Ghosh
hook: An introduction to the Purushottam and to the way Chakraborty understands Thakur in relation to earlier spiritual teachers.
